articles.title_en: Disemployment Effects of Unemployment Insurance: A Meta-analysis
articles.title_cn: 失业保险的就业抑制效应：一项元分析
articles.abstract_en: We systematically review studies of how unemployment benefits affect unemployment duration. Statistically significant findings are eight times more likely to be published. Correcting for publication bias cuts the average elasticity by a third. Meta-analysis is a data-driven way to aggregate estimates across policy contexts and generalize sufficient statistics methods to compute the global optimal policy. Although existing consumption drop-based approaches typically imply an optimal replacement rate near zero, our corrected estimates imply an optimal replacement rate of 28 percent in the United States. We are unable to reject the hypothesis that the “micro” elasticity is equal to the “macro” elasticity. (JEL E24, J64, J65)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们系统性地回顾了关于失业救济金如何影响失业持续时间的研究。统计显著的研究结果被发表的可能性高出八倍。校正发表偏倚后，平均弹性降低了三分之一。元分析是一种数据驱动的方法，用于跨政策背景汇总估计，并将充分统计量方法推广以计算全球最优政策。尽管现有的基于消费下降的方法通常暗示最优替代率接近于零，但我们的校正估计表明，在美国，最优替代率为28%。我们无法拒绝“微观”弹性等于“宏观”弹性的假设。(JEL E24, J64, J65)

articles.title_en: Rational Inattention during a Randomized Controlled Trial
articles.title_cn: 随机对照试验中的理性疏忽
articles.abstract_en: We introduce an information provision experiment into a standard dynamic rational inattention model. We derive analytical results about how the treatment effect varies with characteristics of the environment and the individual. We use these results to discuss findings in the empirical literature on information provision experiments that can be explained by rational inattention of survey respondents and what this interpretation implies about behavior outside the survey. (JEL C90, D83, D91)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将信息提供实验引入标准动态理性疏忽模型中。我们推导出关于处理效应如何随环境和个体特征变化的解析结果。我们利用这些结果讨论信息提供实验实证文献中的发现，这些发现可由调查受访者的理性疏忽解释，并探讨这一解释对调查之外行为的意义。（JEL C90, D83, D91）

articles.title_en: Nonbinary and Transgender Identities and Earnings: Evidence from a National Census
articles.title_cn: 非二元与跨性别身份及收入：来自全国人口普查的证据
articles.abstract_en: We provide the first evidence from a large population census on earnings disparities experienced by nonbinary people—individuals who do not exclusively identify as men or women—and transgender people—individuals whose gender differs from their sex assigned at birth—relative to cisgender people. Using restricted-access 2021 Canadian census data linked to tax records, we find that nonbinary individuals assigned male at birth, transgender men, transgender women, and cisgender women all earn significantly less than comparable cisgender men. Nonbinary individuals assigned female at birth experience an additional earnings penalty. Differences in job sorting explain some of these disparities. (JEL J16, J31, J71)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了来自大型人口普查的首个证据，关于非二元人群——即不 exclusively 认同为男性或女性的个体——以及跨性别者——即性别与出生时指定性别不同的个体——相对于顺性别者所经历的收入差距。利用与税务记录关联的受限访问的2021年加拿大人口普查数据，我们发现出生时被指定为男性的非二元个体、跨性别男性、跨性别女性和顺性别女性均显著低于可比的顺性别男性。出生时被指定为女性的非二元个体则面临额外的收入惩罚。工作分类的差异解释了部分这些差距。(JEL J16, J31, J71)

articles.title_en: Breadwinner’s Burden: The Effect of Financial Concerns on Sleeplessness
articles.title_cn: 养家者的负担：财务担忧对失眠的影响
articles.abstract_en: Using a regression discontinuity design, we find that eligible household heads surveyed just after an unconditional cash transfer in Indonesia report a 0.4 standard deviation improvement in sleep quality compared to those surveyed just before, and they perform better on cognitive tasks sensitive to sleep deprivation. The cash transfer appears to alleviate financial concerns for household heads—typically the breadwinners—improving their sleep. Postdisbursement, eligible households increase savings and reduce debts, and household heads feel less worried, frustrated, and tired. These effects are not observed in ineligible household heads or other members of eligible households. (JEL D12, D91, G51, I38, O12, O16)
articles.abstract_cn: 利用断点回归设计，我们发现，在印度尼西亚无条件现金转移支付后不久接受调查的符合条件的户主，与在支付前接受调查的相比，睡眠质量改善了0.4个标准差，并且在对睡眠剥夺敏感的认知任务上表现更好。现金转移似乎缓解了户主（通常是养家者）的财务担忧，改善了他们的睡眠。支付后，符合条件的家庭增加了储蓄并减少了债务，户主感到更少的担忧、沮丧和疲惫。这些效应在不符合条件的户主或符合条件的家庭的其他成员中并未观察到。(JEL D12, D91, G51, I38, O12, O16)

articles.abstract_en: We show that existing “production approaches” to markdown estimation do not separately identify factor price markdowns from factor-augmenting productivity levels. We propose a method to overcome this challenge and apply it to study the effects of ownership liberalization in Chinese nonferrous metal industries. We find that private firms have much higher labor-augmenting productivity levels than state-owned enterprises (SOEs). However, we also find that private firms exert higher monopsony power over their workers than SOEs, although this only holds for domestically owned firms. This suggests that privatization policies imply a trade-off between increased productivity and monopsony power. (JEL D24, F23, J42, L33, L61, L72, P31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，现有的“生产方法”在估算加价时无法将要素价格加价与要素增强型生产率水平区分开来。我们提出了一种克服这一挑战的方法，并将其应用于研究中国有色金属行业所有权自由化的影响。我们发现，私营企业的劳动增强型生产率水平远高于国有企业。然而，我们也发现，私营企业对工人施加的买方垄断力高于国有企业，尽管这仅适用于国内所有的企业。这表明私有化政策意味着生产率提升与买方垄断力之间的权衡。（JEL D24, F23, J42, L33, L61, L72, P31）

articles.title_en: Minority Salience and Criminal Justice Decisions
articles.title_cn: 少数族裔显著性对刑事司法决策的影响
articles.abstract_en: Decision-makers can exhibit biases when they overemphasize particularly salient features under limited attention. We exploit a sudden salience shock involving individuals of Moroccan descent to examine biases within the Dutch criminal justice system. The salience shock concerned the assassination of a defense attorney by organized crime and thus specifically targeted the justice system. Leveraging high-quality data covering arrest through appeal, we find no impact on police or prosecutor decisions but uncover a 71 percent increase in sentence lengths imposed by judges on salient individuals. Heterogeneity analyses suggest that judge experience with minority suspects can mitigate bias in more discretionary decisions. (JEL D91, J15, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 决策者在有限注意力下过度强调某些显著特征时，可能会表现出偏见。我们利用涉及摩洛哥裔个体的突然显著性冲击来考察荷兰刑事司法系统中的偏见。该显著性冲击涉及一名辩护律师被有组织犯罪暗杀，因此特别针对司法系统。利用涵盖从逮捕到上诉的高质量数据，我们发现对警察或检察官决策没有影响，但发现法官对显著个体判处的刑期长度增加了71%。异质性分析表明，法官与少数族裔嫌疑人的经验可以在更具裁量权的决策中减轻偏见。(JEL D91, J15, K42)

articles.title_en: Substitution Bias and Fixed-Weight Price Indices in Time-Dependent Pricing Models
articles.title_cn: 时间依赖定价模型中的替代偏差与固定权重价格指数
articles.abstract_en: This paper compares measured inflation in true and fixed-weight price indices. We construct model-based inflation measures in time-dependent pricing models that are analogous to measures of inflation in the data—for example, the consumer price index. In the standard new Keynesian model, when inflation rises rapidly, the differences between inflation in those indices and true price indices are increasing in the degree of price stickiness and the elasticity of substitution across goods. For commonly used parameter values, those differences are large and persistent for increases in inflation of the size seen after 2020 in the United States. (JEL E12, E31)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文比较了真实价格指数与固定权重价格指数中测得的通货膨胀。我们在时间依赖定价模型中构建了基于模型的通胀度量，这些度量与数据中的通胀度量（例如消费者价格指数）类似。在标准新凯恩斯模型中，当通胀迅速上升时，这些指数与真实价格指数之间的差异随价格粘性程度和商品间替代弹性的增加而增大。对于常用的参数值，在美国2020年后出现的通胀上升幅度下，这些差异既大又持久。（JEL E12, E31）

articles.title_en: On the Programmability and Uniformity of Digital Currencies
articles.title_cn: 论数字货币的可编程性与统一性
articles.abstract_en: Central bankers argue that programmable digital currencies may compromise the uniformity or singleness of money. We explore this view in a stylized model where programmable money arises endogenously, and differently programmed monies have varying liquidity. Programmability provides private value by easing commitment frictions but imposes social costs under informational frictions. Preserving uniformity is not necessarily socially beneficial. Banning programmable money lowers welfare when informational frictions are mild but improves it when commitment frictions are low. These insights suggest that programmable money could be more beneficial on permissionless blockchains, where it is difficult to commit but trades are publicly observable. (JEL D83, E42, E52, E58)
articles.abstract_cn: 央行官员认为，可编程数字货币可能会损害货币的统一性或单一性。我们在一个程式化模型中探讨了这一观点，其中可编程货币内生地出现，且不同编程的货币具有不同的流动性。可编程性通过缓解承诺摩擦提供私人价值，但在信息摩擦下施加社会成本。保持统一性并不一定对社会有益。当信息摩擦较轻时，禁止可编程货币会降低福利，但当承诺摩擦较低时则会提高福利。这些见解表明，可编程货币在无需许可的区块链上可能更有益，因为在那里难以承诺但交易公开可观察。(JEL D83, E42, E52, E58)
